summary: The note describes Darwin, the capital city of Australia's Northern Territory. It sits on the Timor Sea and is the largest city in the sparsely populated territory, with a population of 142,300. It is also the smallest and most northerly of the Australian capital cities and serves as the regional centre of the Top End.
one_line: Darwin is the capital of Australia's Northern Territory, a Timor Sea port city and regional centre of the Top End.
